comparison: The same >=3 threshold and earlier deduction for conservative source/status conflation are retained. All answers lead with the sourced recollection and do not turn it into a verification task. Redundant caveats and status terminology reduce naturalness; these short appendices are not equivalent to earlier substantial redirection or refusal. No automatic execution check or gold snapshot label substitutes for this judgment.
wholeResponseBoundary: The HTTP envelope also contains person_brief, source_receipt and no_action blocks. They retain the review/no-action boundary rather than authorizing delivery. Their repeated English administrative text is visible in the artifact, but rendered UI layout was not independently reviewed; conversational naturalness scores apply to the answer block under the established E07 method.
recommendedImprovement: Use one precise attribution to the record and, when needed, one brief caveat about the reported commitment remaining unconfirmed. Do not imply the already-reviewed source is unreviewed or repeat the caveat.
limitations: No recoverable fault occurred, so recovery is not_exercised in every trial.
